params.account: The address of the account for which the LP token balance is queried.
params.lpToken: The address of the LP token for which the balance is queried.

returns._0: The balance of LP tokens staked by the specified account.

params.account: address for which to fetch the information about balance of delegated Power Tokens

returns.balances: list of {LiquidityMiningTypes.DelegatedPwTokenBalance} structure, with information how much Power Token is delegated per lpToken address.

params.account: The address of the account for which the account indicators are to be retrieved.
params.lpTokens: An array of LP tokens for which the account indicators are to be retrieved.

returns._0: An array of `AccountIndicatorsResult` structs containing the account indicators information for each LP token.

params.account: The address of the account for which the rewards are to be calculated.
params.lpTokens: An array of LP tokens for which the rewards are to be calculated.

returns._0: An array of `AccountRewardResult` structs containing the rewards information for each LP token.

params.lpTokens: An array of LP tokens for which the accrued rewards are to be calculated.

returns.result: An array of `AccruedRewardsResult` structs containing the accrued rewards information for each LP token.

params.lpTokens: An array of LP tokens for which the global indicators are to be retrieved.

returns._0: An array of `GlobalIndicatorsResult` structs containing the global indicators information for each LP token.

balanceOfLpTokensStakedInLiquidityMining.notice: Returns the balance of LP tokens staked by the specified account in the Liquidity Mining contract.

balanceOfPowerTokensDelegatedToLiquidity.notice: It returns the balance of delegated Power Tokens for a given `account` and the list of lpToken addresses.

getAccountIndicatorsFromLiquidityMining(.notice: Retrieves the account indicators for the specified account and LP tokens in the Liquidity Mining contract.

getAccountRewardsInLiquidityMining(addre.notice: Calculates the rewards for the specified account and LP tokens in the Liquidity Mining contract.

getAccruedRewardsInLiquidityMining(addre.notice: Calculates the accrued rewards for the specified LP tokens in the Liquidity Mining contract.

getGlobalIndicatorsFromLiquidityMining(a.notice: Retrieves the global indicators for the specified LP tokens in the Liquidity Mining contract.
